show_update_dialog:
def show_update_dialog(self):
        if self.update_dialog is not None:
            return
        button = [{"name": _("Finish"), "response": Gtk.ResponseType.OK}]
        self.update_meter = Progress(cache_path=True)
        self.update_dot_step = 0
        body = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=24,
                       valign=Gtk.Align.CENTER, hexpand=True, vexpand=True)
        body.set_margin_start(24)
        body.set_margin_end(24)
        self.labels["update_progress"] = Gtk.Label(label=self.update_caption('running'),
                                                   wrap=True, justify=Gtk.Justification.CENTER)
        self.labels["update_gauge"] = Gtk.ProgressBar(show_text=True, hexpand=True)
        self.labels["update_gauge"].set_text('0%')
        body.pack_start(self.labels["update_progress"], False, False, 0)
        body.pack_start(self.labels["update_gauge"], False, False, 0)
        notice = Gtk.Label(label=self.update_caption('notice'), wrap=True,
                           justify=Gtk.Justification.CENTER)
        notice.set_line_wrap_mode(Pango.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
        notice.set_max_width_chars(36)
        body.pack_start(notice, False, False, 0)
        self.update_log_text = ''
        self.labels['update_details'] = Gtk.Expander(label=self.update_caption('details'))
        self.labels['update_details'].set_expanded(True)
        details_scroll = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        details_scroll.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
        details_scroll.set_size_request(-1, 190)
        self.labels["update_log_scroll"] = details_scroll
        details_scroll.get_vadjustment().connect("changed", self.scroll_update_details)
        self.labels['update_log'] = Gtk.TextView(editable=False, cursor_visible=False,
                                                   wrap_mode=Gtk.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
        details_scroll.add(self.labels['update_log'])
        self.labels['update_details'].add(details_scroll)
        self.labels['update_details'].connect('notify::expanded', self.refresh_update_details)
        body.pack_start(self.labels['update_details'], False, False, 0)
        dialog = self._gtk.Dialog(_("Updating"), button, body, self.finish_updating)
        finish = dialog.get_widget_for_response(Gtk.ResponseType.OK)
        finish.get_style_context().add_class('lugoware-update-finish')
        css = Gtk.CssProvider()
        css.load_from_data(b"""
        .lugoware-update-finish { background-image:none; background-color:#252525;
          border:0; border-bottom:0; box-shadow:none; border-radius:.25em; }
        .lugoware-update-finish:active { background-color:#424242; }
        progressbar trough { min-height:30px; background-color:#1c1c1c; border-radius:5px; }
        progressbar progress { min-height:30px; background-color:#2f5631; border-radius:5px; }
        """)
        finish.get_style_context().add_provider(css, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION+50)
        self.labels["update_gauge"].get_style_context().add_provider(css, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION+50)
        dialog.connect("delete-event", self.close_update_dialog)
        dialog.set_response_sensitive(Gtk.ResponseType.OK, False)
        dialog.get_widget_for_response(Gtk.ResponseType.OK).hide()
        dialog.close_blocked = True
        self.update_dialog = dialog
        dialog.connect("destroy", self.stop_update_animation)
        self.stop_update_animation()
        self.update_animation_timer = GLib.timeout_add(500, self.animate_update_progress)
        self._screen.state.updating = True
        self._screen.base_panel.close_update_timer = GLib.timeout_add_seconds(
            300, self.unblock_update_dialog
        )
render_update_progress:
def render_update_progress(self, data):
        message=str(data.get('message','')).strip()
        if message:
            # Bounded UI cache; the complete record remains in the existing log.
            self.update_log_text=(self.update_log_text+'\n'+message)[-32768:].lstrip('\n')
            self.refresh_update_details()
        state=self.update_meter.update(data)
        if state != 'running':
            self.labels['update_progress'].set_text(self.update_caption(state))
            self.stop_update_animation()
        self.labels['update_gauge'].set_fraction(self.update_meter.percent/100)
        self.labels['update_gauge'].set_text(str(self.update_meter.percent)+'%')
        if state=='failed':
            # Keep detailed failure evidence in the existing screen/update logs.
            self.labels['update_progress'].set_tooltip_text(self.update_meter.error)
        if state!='running':
            self.update_dialog.close_blocked=False
        return state!='running'
animate_update_progress:
def animate_update_progress(self):
        if self.update_dialog is None or self.update_meter.state != 'running' or not self._screen.state.updating:
            self.update_animation_timer = None
            return False
        dots = (1, 2, 3, 2)[self.update_dot_step % 4]
        self.update_dot_step += 1
        self.labels['update_progress'].set_text(self.update_caption('running').rstrip('.… ') + ' ' + '.' * dots)
        return True
